name: Tsukada Shun'ichi
source:
"I see... you were Dr. Katsuki's daughter, weren't you?"

He is a lieutenant in the Navy and Shindou Masanari's superior officer. He entered the navy after being in the army, and has a long military career.

He is a strong man who has been through hell and back.

[Translated from [url=https://www.otomate.jp/chouchoujiken/chara/index12.php]official website[/url]]
